**Retransmissions use a new NAS COUNT**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / NAS security / Handling of NAS COUNT and NAS sequence number |
| Tags | security, timing |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 1m58s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | stranding |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.3.1 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 reads "security protected NAS message"; from V15.1.0 "SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE message"; the increase by one after each new or retransmitted message is in every version; Rel-16: from V16.5.1 the overflow counter is "the stored NAS overflow counter", and estimation rules for the receiver follow the sentence; Rel-18: "subclause" becomes "clause")
- TS 24.501 5.5.1.2.8 c) (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 has the AMF enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED on the abort, 5GMM-REGISTERED from V15.7.0; the retransmission wording is unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-RETRANSMIT-NEW-COUNT.md).
